newsitem.title: UK: Ocean firm gets nod on bid for waste firm.
newsitem.headline: Ocean firm gets nod on bid for waste firm.

text.p: Marine and environmental services group Ocean Group Plc said on Monday that a bid by its waste management subsidiary Cory Environmental Ltd for the Waste Company Ltd had been accepted by Gloucestershire County Council.
Ocean said full details of the transaction would be announced as soon as the terms have been agreed. However, Ocean said the consideration would be less than 10 percent of Ocean's net asset value.
Waste Company is a local disposal firm wholly owned by Gloucestershire Country Council, set up in 1992 to manage the county's waste disposal needs.
